outputs.name: Cross-profiler abundances
outputs.rawYaml:
id: taxpasta_profiles
name: Cross-profiler abundances
mode: merge
description: >-
  Every standardised taxpasta table melted into one long frame: one row per
  profiler, database, sample and taxon, with the raw count and the within-run
  relative abundance. The hub every cross-profiler comparison is computed from.
nf_core_url: https://github.com/nf-core/modules/tree/master/modules/nf-core/taxpasta/merge
find: { path_glob: "**/taxpasta/*.tsv" }
recipe: taxpasta/profiles.py
fixture: profiles.tsv
renders_as:
  # long format (run x rank x taxon x abundance) -> stacked_taxonomy fits; a
  # sunburst would need the wide per-rank columns this frame does not carry.
  # One bar per profiling run (profiler x database): each bar keeps one
  # classifier's naming vocabulary, and pools only the samples in scope.
  - {
      id: stacked_taxonomy,
      component: advanced_viz,
      kind: stacked_taxonomy,
      roles: { sample_id: profiler_db, taxon: name, rank: rank, abundance: rel_abundance },
    }
  - {
      component: card,
      column: name,
      aggregation: nunique,
      secondary_layout: uniqueness,
    }
  - {
      component: card,
      column: count,
      aggregation: median,
      aggregations: [box_plot_stats],
      secondary_layout: box_plot,
    }
  - {
      component: card,
      column: sample,
      aggregation: nunique,
      secondary_layout: donut,
      breakdown_col: profiler,
    }
  - {
      component: card,
      column: rel_abundance,
      aggregation: max,
      secondary_layout: threshold,
      threshold_value: 0.5,
      threshold_direction: max,
      threshold_warn: 0.3,
    }
  - { component: interactive, interactive_type: MultiSelect, column_name: profiler }
  - { component: interactive, interactive_type: MultiSelect, column_name: sample }
  - { component: table }
  # Metric cards and the row-level table behind them: the readings the
  # nf-core dashboards were already computing off this output by hand.
  - { component: card, column: rank, aggregation: nunique, secondary_layout: composition, breakdown_col: rank }
  - { component: card, column: rel_abundance, aggregation: max, secondary_layout: gauge, coverage_max: 1 }

outputs.name: Per-run profile statistics
outputs.rawYaml:
id: taxpasta_sample_summary
name: Per-run profile statistics
mode: merge/summary
description: >-
  One row per sample, profiler and database: how many taxa were reported, how
  many reads were assigned, how concentrated the profile is on its top hit, and
  Shannon diversity with Pielou evenness.
nf_core_url: https://github.com/nf-core/modules/tree/master/modules/nf-core/taxpasta/merge
find: { path_glob: "**/taxpasta/*.tsv" }
recipe: taxpasta/sample_summary.py
fixture: sample_summary.tsv
renders_as:
  - {
      id: richness_dot_plot,
      component: advanced_viz,
      kind: dot_plot,
      roles:
        {
          cluster: sample,
          gene: profiler_db,
          mean_expression: shannon,
          frac_expressing: top_taxon_fraction,
        },
    }
  - {
      component: card,
      column: taxa_observed,
      aggregation: median,
      aggregations: [box_plot_stats],
      secondary_layout: box_plot,
    }
  - {
      component: card,
      column: shannon,
      aggregation: average,
      secondary_layout: gauge,
      coverage_max: 6,
    }
  - {
      component: card,
      column: evenness,
      aggregation: average,
      secondary_layout: threshold,
      threshold_value: 0.6,
      threshold_direction: min,
      threshold_warn: 0.4,
    }
  - {
      component: card,
      column: profiler_db,
      aggregation: nunique,
      secondary_layout: top_n,
      breakdown_col: profiler,
      top_n_count: 4,
    }
  - {
      component: card,
      column: assigned_count,
      aggregation: median,
      aggregations: [box_plot_stats],
      secondary_layout: box_plot,
    }
  - {
      component: figure,
      visu_type: scatter,
      dict_kwargs: { x: taxa_observed, y: shannon, color: profiler, symbol: platform },
    }
  # How concentrated a run's profile is: the share its single top taxon holds,
  # which separates classifiers reporting a few dominant taxa from those that
  # spread the same community over a long tail.
  - {
      component: figure,
      visu_type: bar,
      dict_kwargs: { x: profiler_db, y: top_taxon_fraction, color: profiler },
    }
  - { component: table }

outputs.name: Variant calls
outputs.rawYaml:
id: vcf_variants
name: Variant calls
mode: per-variant
description: >-
  One row per variant call, read straight out of the caller's own VCF: locus,
  allele, quality, filter status, genotype, read depth and variant allele
  fraction. Pipeline-agnostic, and the only collection in a variant-calling
  template that is granular enough for a caller-against-caller comparison at
  the variant level rather than at the summary-count level.
find:
  path_glob: "**/variant_calling/**/*.vcf.gz"
  path_glob_alt:
    - "**/variant_calling/*/*/*.vcf.gz"
    - "**/*.filtered.vcf.gz"
recipe: vcf/variants.py
fixture: variants.tsv
renders_as:
  # Depth against allele fraction is the plane a germline callset is read on:
  # a clean diploid run stacks at 0.5 and 1.0, and everything off those two
  # bands is either low coverage or a caller artefact.
  - { id: vaf_against_depth, component: advanced_viz, kind: scatter_xy,
      roles: {x: dp, y: vaf, label: variant_key, color: caller} }
  # Rainfall / density along the genome. The manhattan kind takes chr/pos/score
  # and asks nothing of the score's meaning, so the allele fraction reads as
  # the y axis honestly once `score_kind` says so.
  - { id: variant_rainfall, component: advanced_viz, kind: manhattan,
      roles: {chr: chrom, pos: pos, score: vaf, feature: variant_key} }
  - { id: variant_genome_view, component: advanced_viz, kind: genome_view,
      roles: {chr: chrom, pos: pos, score: vaf, feature: variant_key, sample: caller} }
  - { component: card, column: qual, aggregation: median, aggregations: [box_plot_stats], secondary_layout: box_plot }
  - { component: card, column: dp, aggregation: median, aggregations: [box_plot_stats], secondary_layout: box_plot }
  - { component: card, column: vaf, aggregation: average, aggregations: [box_plot_stats], secondary_layout: box_plot }
  - { component: figure, visu_type: histogram, dict_kwargs: {x: vaf, color: caller} }
  - { component: table }

mode: filter-summary
description: >-
  One row per caller and FILTER value: how many calls carry it, how they split
  between transitions and transversions, and what share of the callset they
  are. The per-caller view the pooled MultiQC panel cannot give.
find:
  path_glob: "**/*.FILTER.summary"
recipe: vcftools/filter_summary.py
fixture: filter_summary.tsv
renders_as:
  - { id: filter_partition, component: figure, visu_type: bar,
      dict_kwargs: {x: caller, y: n_variants, color: filter_label, barmode: stack} }
  - { component: card, column: pct_of_calls, aggregation: average, secondary_layout: donut,
      breakdown_col: filter_label }
  - { component: card, column: n_variants, aggregation: sum, secondary_layout: top_n,
      breakdown_col: caller, top_n_count: 3 }
  - { component: card, column: ts_tv, aggregation: median, aggregations: [box_plot_stats],
      secondary_layout: box_plot }
  - { component: table }
